text:
sara_cs: forwarding from AcmePayments — after the 13:38 deploy their latency dashboard shows p50 still present but p95/p99 lines are absent. They also saw intermittent 502s around 13:41-13:43. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/resp123 (they pasted image). They're escalating, asking if this is a known cutover side-effect or a config regression. :frowning:

dan_support: thanks — can you paste the exact panel query and the time-range they used? also did they apply any dashboard variable filters? :eyes:

sara_cs: panel query (copied from their Grafana):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,route))
```
Time range: 13:30 - 14:00 UTC. Filters: route=\"/v1/generate\". They said p50 panel is a direct gauge (redwood_request_p50) which still renders.

mike_sre: looking through infra logs — noticed an ingest mapping change at 2024-07-22T13:38:10Z that renamed some histogram metrics. grep from collector logs:
```
2024-07-22T13:38:10Z INFO metrics-mapper: applying rename rule "redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket -> rwd_req_duration_seconds_bucket"
```
If buckets were renamed, histogram_quantile on the old name would return nothing while precomputed gauges (p50/p95 gauges) might still exist or be handled separately.

metrics-bot: [auto] metric-mapper change detected in prod: mapping id=ingest-rename-20240722 by jules_platform at 13:38:10 UTC. Affected metrics: redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket -> rwd_req_duration_seconds_bucket

jules_platform: that staging change got promoted during canary — I ran the mapping job to align new collector naming. I didn't expect dashboards to still reference old metric names; sorry. I pushed it at 13:38 as part of the pipeline. Rolling back or adding compatibility aliases is quick but want to confirm impact window.

dan_support: OK. To repro locally: hit an endpoint and then query Prometheus for the bucket series. example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# then in promql console:
count_over_time(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])
```
If that returns 0 while rwd_req_duration_seconds_bucket has counts, that'll confirm rename is the issue.

sara_cs: I ran the curl test in staging at 13:50 and queried Prometheus — redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket had no series, rwd_req_duration_seconds_bucket had fresh samples. Quick paste of promql results: 
```
> count_over_time(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])
0
> count_over_time(rwd_req_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])
42
```
Customer confirmed same behavior in prod.

mike_sre: suggested remediation: (1) add back compatibility alias in ingest mapping (short term) or (2) update dashboards to point at new name (longer-term). I can do (1) as a hotfix. I'll open infra ticket and roll the alias now. ETA 20-30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: deploy 4567 (ingest-mapping-compat) queued by mike_sre. Plan: apply mapping alias to map rwd_req_duration_seconds_bucket -> redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket (compat). Target rollout: canary -> prod.

jules_platform: also sanity-checking dashboard templates — we should update all saved queries to use the canonical new name and add a fallback layer in the metrics adapter so future renames don't break panels. I'll file a cleanup PR after the hotfix.

dan_support: messaging to customer: told them we're investigating, identified a mapping rename as likely root cause, and offered two options: immediate rollback/alias (we're doing) or patch dashboards (safer). They accepted alias hotfix and asked for timeline and RCA when done.

mike_sre: hotfix applied at 13:58:20 UTC. Verifying panels now.
metrics-bot: [auto] mapping alias applied successfully at 13:58:20 UTC — compatibility rule in effect.

sara_cs: customer reports p95/p99 lines reappearing on dashboard at ~14:03 UTC and 502s subsided. Confirmed by screenshots they uploaded. :tada:

mike_sre: follow-ups — rollout revert is scheduled: we'll push a cleanup PR to update all dashboards and remove alias after one week. I'll create infra ticket INF-8242 for root-cause/RCAs and postmortem notes. Closing fast lane. :white_check_mark:

sara_cs: updating customer thread with timeline and next steps. thanks team.
